Zomm is a Doppelganger in the Under Temple Cave Area under the Open Hand Temple in Act Three.

Involvement

Main article: Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders

Zomm and his fellow doppelgangers are responsible for several murders, including  Father Lorgan. Zomm attacks on sight, together with  Muzz and  Rudd.

Notes

Zomm is disguised in female form.

Combat

Attacks and actions

Zomm has the statistics, attacks, and abilities of a generic doppelganger.

Damage: 5~10
1d6 + 4⁠Piercing

 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Morphic Ambush ()

Undergo a shocking transformation to startle your foes. Successfully  Ambushed entities are more susceptible to your attacks.

 Range: Self
 Recharge: Per combat
 Multiattack ()
Damage: 12~32

Speak with Dead

  • Who are you?
    • Zomm
      Zomm... Faceless... Eater of men...
  • Did you kill Father Lorgan?
    • Zomm
      No... Dolor did... Splendid... Kill...
  • What were you doing here?
    • Zomm
      Cleaning up... Dolor... Messy...
      • Zomm
        Left his dagger... Careless...
  • Who is Dolor?
    • Zomm
      Our blood-red dwarf... Tricky... Hungry...
  • Where is Dolor now?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*
  • Is Dolor one of you?
    • Zomm
      Yes... But wants... More...
  • What does Dolor want?
    • Zomm
      Transcendence...
  • Who do you work for?
    • Zomm
      We... We...
      • Narrator
        *The corpse tries to speak, but something prevents it.*
  • Why did you want this dagger so much?
    • Zomm
      Strong... Paralyses...
  • How many more of you are there?
    • Narrator
      *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.*
  • I found this flowery key. What is it for?
    • Zomm
      Flophouse... Dolor's secrets...
